_comment: Shared with the app (health-without-borders-frontend, retiredDeviceHash). hash = sha256 hex of prefix + normalized, where normalized keeps only the hex digits of the UID, in upper case (the app's normalizeNfcUid). A UID with no hex digit has no hash. Hashes checked with `printf 'hwb-retired-device:v1:04A1B2C3D4E5F6' | sha256sum`.
